shellCommands.command: cat index.html .gitignore tsconfig.json vite.config.ts; find src __agent_eval__ -type f | head -50; for f in $(find src -type f); do echo "--- $f"; cat $f; done; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && ls build/esm/components/Table build/esm/components/Table/hoc build/esm/components/Pagination 2>/dev/null; cat build/esm/components/Table/hoc/withTableSorting/withTableSorting.d.ts build/esm/components/Table/hoc/withTableSelection/withTableSelection.d.ts build/esm/components/Pagination/Pagination.d.ts; sed -n 1,200p build/esm/components/Table/Table.d.ts; cat build/esm/components/Table/hoc/withTableSelection/withTableSelection.js | head -120

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm && grep -n "static getRowId" -A 14 components/Table/Table.js; ls components/Pagination/i18n components/Table/i18n; grep -n "lang" components/utils/configure.d.ts utils/configure.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; grep -n "Lang\b" -r components/utils/configure.d.ts | head -3; cd ../..; grep -n '"Label\|ru' build/esm/components/utils/configure.d.ts | head

rm -rf dist && git status --short; ls node_modules | grep -E "^(jsdom|happy-dom|playwright|puppeteer|@testing-library)" ; ls node_modules/@testing-library 2>/dev/null; which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs | head -30
